At the outset when learned counsel for the respondent/State referred the criminal record of applicant consisting of four cases including offence under Section 302 of IPC and another offence Laxmi Kushwaha vs The State Of M.P. on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100600614/
1 under Section 376 of IPC, then counsel for the applicant seeks withdrawal of this application so far as applicant No.1-Laxmi Kushwaha is concerned.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He undertakes to renew the prayer after sometime.
Prayer noted.
Application stands dismissed as withdrawn so far as applicant No.1-Laxmi Kushwaha is concerned.
Heard with consent on bail application in respect of applicant No.2-Sonu Kushwaha.
The applicants have filed this FIRST bail application u/S 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

Applicants have been arrested on 06.11.2022, by Police Station Jatara, District Tikamgarh, in connection with Crime No.313/2022, for the offence punishable under Section 307, 324, 323, 294, 506, 34 of IPC.
It is the submission of learned counsel for the applicant that he is suffering confinement since 06.11.2022 and the charge-sheet has already been filed.
Complainant is family member/uncle of the applicant and dispute erupted all of a sudden because of some irrigation related problem.
No premeditation exists in the commission of the offence.
Role of the applicant is confined to inflict lathi blow to the other side.
Simple injuries have been sustained by the victim out of such blows.
Looking to his age, chance be given for course correction and to mend his ways to become better citizen.
Confinement amounts to pretrial detention.
He undertakes to cooperate in trial and will abide by all the terms and conditions as imposed by this court.

He further undertakes to perform community service to purge his misdeeds if any and to serve National/Environmental/Social Cause and he would not be a source of embarrassment or harassment to the complainant.
Under these grounds, counsel prayed for bail.
Learned Government Advocate for the State opposed the prayer and prayed for its dismissal.
Heard learned counsel for the parties at length and perused the case diary.

Considering the above submissions advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and the fact situation, a chance be given to him for course correction, without commenting on the merits of the case, and as per the spirit of community service echoed in the order of Sunita Gandharva Vs. State of M.P. reported in 2020(3) MPLJ (Cri.) 247, the application is allowed.

8. It is made clear that this bail is granted once the case is made out for bail and thereafter, direction for plantation of saplings is given and it is not the case where a person intends to serve social cause can be given bail without considering the merits.
